name: StartupBeat

sources.title: Get featured — paid route via 'Publicize Originals': journalist interview + sponsored article published on 6 publications including StartUp Beat; contact info@startupbeat.com / +1 (646) 480-0356

Contact — 'To pitch a story about your startup, or to submit a guest article to StartupBeat, please contact' the editor email (Cloudflare-obfuscated); staff list: editor Jim Glade, writer Stiven Cartagena

conditions: Free route is an editorial email pitch (story idea or guest article) — acceptance is at the editor's discretion
The advertised 'Get featured' route is PAID: a Publicize Originals sponsored-article package across 6 publications
requirements: A newsworthy startup story or a guest article — the site runs funding news, founder stories, advice pieces
For the paid route: budget for Publicize Originals (interview → 1 sponsored article → 6 publications)
Email access — the pitch inbox is Cloudflare email-obfuscated on the contact page (info@startupbeat.com also appears on the get-featured page for PR/media support)
preparation: A story pitch: funding round, launch milestone, or founder angle
For a guest article: a finished draft on a startup-adjacent topic
workflow: Choose the route: free editorial pitch vs paid Publicize Originals
Free: email the editorial contact listed on startupbeat.com/contact/ (or info@startupbeat.com) with the pitch
Paid: sign up at publicize.co/originals, complete the journalist interview, and include StartUp Beat among the 6 target publications
Follow up once if no reply — no tracking exists
watchFor: The 'Get featured' page leads with the paid sponsored-article product — don't mistake it for a free submission form
Editorial pitch email is obfuscated; use the contact page or info@startupbeat.com
Sponsored articles are labeled as such ('Publicize Originals' writes sponsored content) — paid coverage is disclosed
Site is active (recent funding stories) but the pitch funnel is email-only
countsAsLive: An article about the startup or by the founder is published on startupbeat.com (news, startup pitches, perspective, or advice sections)
unknowns: Editorial response rate on cold pitches
Whether guest articles carry a dofollow link to the company
